description: A developer's profile: name, website, country, app count, total ratings and installs, all their apps (most-rated first) and the same company in the other store. get_app shows the developer id as dev <store>:<id>. Cost: 1 credits.

dev.description: `apple:<artist id>`, `play:<developer id>`, a numeric Apple artist id, a Play developer id (often the name), or the website domain (`spotify.com`). Example: apple:324684583

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

name: get_developer
title: Get Developer
